IE 7500 — Applied Natural Language Processing in Engineering | prerequisites, offerings, professors (Northeastern)

NU Map is an independent, student-built planner — not affiliated with, endorsed by, or officially connected to Northeastern University. Data comes from the public catalog on a schedule; confirm with the official catalog and an advisor.

4 semester hoursGraduateLectureusually offered: fall, springtypical days: WBostonOnlineSeattle, WAVancouver, CanadaLive CastOnlineTraditional

Covers fundamentals of natural language processing and its applications in engineering areas. Presents an overview of the NLP concepts and important algorithms. Demonstrates applications of NLP to address engineering problems in transportation, civil engineering, manufacturing, healthcare, business, commerce, and selected other areas of engineering. A substantial course project offers students an opportunity to solidify their skills to apply NLP to practical engineering problems.

Prerequisites

(IE 5374 (min C) or IE 5374 (min D) or IE 6200 (min C) or IE 6400 (min C) or MATH 7241 (min C))
